outputs.explanation: This is a native MS spectrum (line plot of relative intensity vs. mass) showing a single measurement with labeled peaks; line plots/spectra are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Same as panel A: a single native MS spectrum (line plot), which is exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.

Bar chart showing the proportion of protein species bound to 0-3 metal atoms as derived directly from a single native MS spectrum (analogous to panels A/B). No error bars are shown and no replicate averaging is indicated, so this represents raw compositional data rather than a mean of independent replicates; individual data points are not applicable here.
Same as panel C: bar chart of metal-bound fractions derived from a single native MS measurement, not an average across replicates, so individual points are not applicable.
